features.name: GitHub app authentication
features.description: Service-to-service authentication method for AL Go using GitHub app ID and private key instead of personal access tokens, reducing security risk of token exposure.
features.status_evidence_quote: everything that you'll see here is in preview um so we'll go through what's new
caveats: GitHub packages still requires fine-grained tokens
Create release functionality does not yet work with GitHub app authentication

features.name: Embed secrets in install apps
features.description: Ability to use secret references with dollar sign and curly brackets in install apps and install test apps settings to avoid exposing secrets in source code or logs.
features.status_evidence_quote: everything that you'll see here is in preview

features.name: Incremental builds
features.description: Performance enhancement that builds and publishes only modified apps instead of complete builds, reducing build and publish time and avoiding republishing unchanged apps. Apps maintain version numbers reflecting when they were built.
caveats: Not enabled by default
Can be configured per trigger type (push, pull request, schedule)
Modified apps or modified projects mode options
Requires workflow concurrency configuration for optimal performance
Branch-specific only
Release branches currently do not use releases as baseline for incremental builds

features.name: Workflow concurrency
features.description: Ability to manage workflow execution when using incremental builds, preventing concurrent builds when changes are made and restarting builds with latest changes.
caveats: Needs to be set in conditional settings or workflow-specific settings file

features.name: Push test apps to online environments
features.description: Optional ability to push test apps to online environments as part of the AL Go workflow. Ability to publish test apps to sandbox environments for running AI tests and other test toolkits on demand, avoiding cost of running tests on every build.
caveats: AI tests not yet ready for automated CI/CD runs
Requires new version of test libraries (expected October or later, not before April 1st) to deploy test apps
Current test libraries have insecure functionality blocking online deployment
Includes settings to exclude specific app IDs
Does not support dependencies to test libraries

features.name: Include test apps in sandbox environment setting
features.description: Deploy setting that automatically deploys all test apps and dependencies to sandbox when deploying apps. Allows exclusion of specific app IDs.
caveats: Does not support dependencies to test libraries

features.name: MS AL-Go deprecations documentation
features.description: Published list of functionality changes that require setting adjustments, with defined timelines for when changes take effect.

features.name: Clean mode pre-processor symbols deprecation
features.description: Changes to in effect after April 1st replacing clean mode pre-processor symbols with conditional settings using build modes.

features.name: Always build all projects setting deprecation
features.description: Setting deprecated in favor of setting onpo request to false in incremental bills, effective after October 1st.

features.name: Workflow schedule setting migration
features.description: Dynamic setting key for schedule and workflow name will change to workflow-specific setting called workflow schedule, effective after October 1st.
features.status_evidence_quote: the setting where like the schedule and the workflow name is is a like a dynamic setting key name uh will be changed to

features.name: Private repository support in AL-Go
features.description: AL-Go can be forked into a private org that supports private repos and deploys template repos from a fork into private repos in the same private fork.
caveats: Customization capabilities for indirect templates still in PR and not yet available

features.name: GitHub apps support
features.description: GitHub apps are currently not supported in version 6.1 and require updating to preview, with general availability in version 6.4.
features.status_evidence_quote: GitHub abs are currently not supported in version 6.1 you would need to update to um is it 6.3 or preview preview preview right
caveats: Not available in 6.1
Currently in preview

features.name: Last known good build detection
features.description: Build system identifies last good build as the last successful build on the same branch, using it as baseline for determining what apps need rebuilding.
caveats: Branch-specific only
Release branches currently do not use releases as baseline for incremental builds

features.name: Container Helper Telemetry
features.description: Streaming telemetry improvements for container helper that provide more detailed diagnostic information. Discussion of enabling old container helper telemetry as a potential enhancement.
caveats: may require issue creation to enable

features.name: AL Go Architecture Transition
features.description: Future plan to stop using container helper and create a different mechanism for building over the next two to three years as AL Go evolves.
features.status_evidence_quote: in the future the the as go algo will stop using container hel so over the next two to three years algo will will
caveats: timeline is two to three years
overrides and customizations will change

features.name: Override Functions for Run Pipeline
features.description: Container helper settings and override functions that allow customization of the build pipeline, including the ability to place custom scripts in the AL Go folder.
caveats: requires knowledge of container helper settings documentation

features.name: Trusted Signing in AL Go
features.description: Support for trusted signing on Azure as an alternative to certificate-based signing within containers, using keyboard-based certificate storage.
caveats: old mechanism inside container is harder to maintain

features.name: AL Go GitHub Adoption Metrics
features.description: Telemetry shows approximately 2,500 repositories using AL Go for GitHub with running workflows, and the majority are on the latest version.
caveats: telemetry cannot identify specific updating users
only aggregate statistics available

features.name: Runtime Packages without Full Dependencies
features.description: Request for runtime packages capability that doesn't require full app dependencies, only symbols. The team determined the AL compiler won't deliver this, so they must create workflows to automate runtime package creation with full dependencies.
caveats: full apps of dependencies are still required
automation workflows needed but not yet automated

features.name: Template Capabilities for Repository Management
features.description: Customization capabilities and indirect templates allowing creation of templates for app repositories to standardize configuration across multiple repositories.
caveats: under investigation
details limited

features.name: PowerBI Dashboards for Repository Monitoring
features.description: Partners creating PowerBI dashboards to monitor and manage multiple AL Go repositories, potentially using telemetry or GitHub APIs.
caveats: unclear whether using telemetry or GitHub APIs
community-driven efforts

features.name: Federated credentials for Azure subscriptions
features.description: Support for federated credentials to connect GitHub to Azure subscriptions, avoiding the need to store credentials. Currently still requires Azure credentials to be created initially.
caveats: still requires Azure credentials to be created
may need additional GitHub to ADO functionality

features.name: Runtime packages for AppSource apps
features.description: Ability to expose runtime packages for AppSource apps is not supported currently due to IP protection concerns. Being explored with opt-in mechanism for partners.
caveats: IP protection concerns
potential legal issues with existing partners
opt-in model not yet implemented

features.name: Multiple NuGet feeds support
features.description: Partners want ability to define multiple NuGet feeds to share different runtime packages with different partners. This feature is being requested and considered.
caveats: might be an easy fix but not yet implemented

features.name: Scheduled deployment outside working hours
features.description: Ability to schedule deployments to environments at specific times outside working hours using a YAML file in GitHub workflows. Partners are deploying Friday evenings at specific times.
caveats: not available in UI settings yet
requires manual YAML file addition

features.name: Custom build checks in AL Go
features.description: Ability to implement custom build checks beyond what AL Go provides. Users need to write their own workflows similar to what BC apps repository does.
caveats: not built into AL Go
requires custom workflow creation

features.name: Container-based build optimization
features.description: Standard AL Go setup uses containers for building taking 15-20 minutes. Looking at ways to optimize by using different project structures and only using containers for tests.
caveats: current standard process is slow
optimizations require multiple projects

features.name: Use compiler folder setting
features.description: Setting called use compiler folder that when set to true combined with do not publish apps reduces build time to 3-4 minutes but prevents test execution.
caveats: prevents test execution
only for projects without tests

features.name: Multi-project build and test strategy
features.description: Strategy to build all apps fast using compiler folder in one project, then run tests in separate projects for faster feedback on build failures.
caveats: requires multiple repository projects

features.name: Online sandbox testing for AL Go
features.description: Ability to run tests in online sandboxes instead of containers is being worked on but not currently possible in AL Go.
features.status_evidence_quote: run the tests in online sandboxes which is not possible right now but it's something we are we've been working on
caveats: not yet available
still in development

features.name: Compiler folder optimization
features.description: Using compiler folder to fail fast in testing, though total setup time remains the same as tests must still deploy and run.
caveats: total setup time is not reduced
tests must still deploy and run

features.name: Testing performance improvements investigation
features.description: The team is aware of testing performance concerns and is looking into what can be done better.
caveats: no specific timeline or commitment given
